messages.content: Hello! I'm the City of Doral AI Assistant. I can help you with information about city services, permits, events, parks, and more. How can I assist you today?
How do I apply for a fence permit?

**Requirements:**
• Max 6ft rear, 4ft front
• DERM approval needed
• Within property lines

**Steps:**
1. Get DERM approval
2. Prepare documents
3. Apply online

**Contact:**
• Building Dept: (305) 593-6700
• Email: building@cityofdoral.com
I need to report vandalism

**Report Options:**
• Online via Doral 311
• Call (305) 593-6699
• Visit Police Dept

**Info Needed:**
• Location, date, details
• Photos of damage
• Witness info (if any)

**Next Steps:**
1. Receive case number
2. Assigned to officer
3. Get police report

**Contacts:**
• Doral 311: cityofdoral.com/311 
• Police Non-Emergency: (305) 593-6699
What youth programs are available?

**Sports Leagues:**
• Basketball, Soccer, Baseball
• Flag Football, Broncos Cheer

**Swim Lessons:**
• Parent & Tot, Preschool
• Learn to Swim, Advanced

**Enrichment Programs:**
• Coding, Robotics, Science
• Crafts, Karate, Aikido  

**Camps:**
• Summer, Winter, Spring
• Holiday themed camps

**Registration:**
• Online or In-person
• Proof of residency required

**Contact:**
• (305) 593-6600
• doralparksinfo@cityofdoral.com
I need to report a pothole

**Reporting Options:**
• Doral 311 Portal
• Call (305) 593-6740
• Email publicworks@cityofdoral.com

**What to Include:**
• Location/address 
• Pothole size
• Photos (if possible)

**Response Time:**
• Emergency: 24 hours
• Standard: 3-7 days
• Major repairs: Scheduled

**Important Notes:**
• City maintains public roads
• Private/HOA: Contact them
• County/State: 311/FDOT

**Contact:**
• Doral 311: cityofdoral.com/311
• Public Works: (305) 593-6740
When do I renew my business tax receipt?

**Renewal Deadlines:**
• Fiscal Year: Oct 1 - Sep 30
• Renew by: September 30th

**Late Penalties:**
• After Sep 30: 10% 
• After Oct 31: 15%
• After Nov 30: 20%

**Online Renewal:**
1. Log into CSS Portal
2. Navigate to 'My Licenses'
3. Renew & pay online

**Other Options:**
• In-Person at City Hall
• By Mail with renewal notice

**Contact:**
• (305) 593-6631
• btrlicensing@cityofdoral.com
